## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND and SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +0.64%) alongside TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +0.58%) — mixed risk signals confirm neutral stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Commodity/energy reflation: XLE (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +15.23%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +13.50%) ABOVE TREND driving risk-on impulses for cyclicals. Volatility creeping: VXX (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND while credit is steady — HYG (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.47%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: TLT (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +0.58%) ABOVE TREND indicates bond demand; dollar and yield indicators are flagged NEUTRAL in the regime data (no directional breakouts). Net is mixed financial conditions easing slightly but not decisively.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leadership: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +15.23%) and Materials/Mfg strength (MOO (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -0.62%) and Consumer Discretionary XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -4.37%) — style: cyclicals/value showing relative strength vs growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mixed: SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +0.64%) while EM and Japan outperformance — EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +6.40%) and EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.29% | 1M: +10.17%); China FXI NEUTRAL (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.00%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Small caps and cyclicals show risk-on appetite: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +3.33%). Thematic/crypto risk appetite is weak: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -10.07%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.29% | 1M: -22.15%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity bid: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +13.50%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +3.05%), TAN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.37% | 1M: +16.51%) — commodities confirming reflation tilt.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy robust: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +15.23%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +11.10%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.57% | 1M: +10.60%); natural gas divergent in CORRECTION: UNG (1W: -4.17% | 1M: +7.99%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: broad sector breadth (9/11) and commodity/energy ETFs (XLE, BNO, GLD) ABOVE TREND support cyclical leadership; Divergences: major weakness in crypto/thematics (IBIT, ETHA, ARKK) and persistent tech weakness (XLK BELOW TREND) create mixed internal market character.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy and commodity themes showing strength (XLE (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +15.23%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +13.50%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to tech/thematic risk (XLK BELOW TREND, ARKK BELOW TREND); maintain neutral duration posture given TLT ABOVE TREND but mixed risk signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +15.23%) ABOVE TREND, MOO (1W: +4.04% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -0.62%) BELOW TREND, XLY (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -4.37%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +9.34% | 1M: +13.50%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +11.10%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +2.48% | 1M: +3.05%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -4.17% | 1M: +7.99%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (volatility threshold to signal complacency vs risk), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health watchpoint), XLK/XLF ratio (watch for growth vs value pivot), SPY downside confirmed if SPY closes persistently below recent correction support.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Energy and commodities showing strength (XLE, GLD, TAN) while Tech and thematic risk remain weak (XLK, ARKK, IBIT). Key risk: rising short-term volatility (VXX ABOVE TREND) and sharp crypto/thematic drawdowns warrant monitoring.
